# Thamin (ثمين)

> Thamin is the smart pricing platform of Beyond Style UAE, a fashion
> accessories business in the United Arab Emirates. It calculates selling
> prices from real costs (supplier, packaging, delivery, payment fees, VAT,
> marketing, operations), protects a minimum profit margin, produces customer
> quotations in Arabic and English, and keeps a full audit trail of every
> price decision.

## Key facts
- Name: Thamin (Arabic: ثمين, meaning "precious"; from ثمن, "price")
- Operator: Beyond Style UAE
- Market: United Arab Emirates (prices in AED, VAT 5%)
- Languages: Arabic (RTL) and English (LTR)
- Platform: Progressive Web App (installable on Android), built with Next.js
- Honest product claims: items are stainless steel fashion accessories with
  gold-tone or silver-tone finishing; the platform never claims real gold,
  real silver, waterproof or anti-tarnish unless verified
- Pricing rule: every displayed price is computed by a deterministic formula
  engine; AI assistance never sets a final price directly

## Pages
- /login: team sign-in (Admin, Manager, Sales, Viewer roles)
- /install: install the Android app (PWA)
- Internal tools (authentication required): price calculator, product costing,
  supplier database, material rates, customer quotations, dashboard, alerts,
  price history, message templates, pricing assistant
